name: Eliza Willett Nicoll
bioAdditions: Daughter of Henry Nicoll and Elizabeth Woodhull, daughter of Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull (S1, S2): Bull Smith -> Richard 2d -> Sarah (m. Nathaniel Woodhull) -> Gen. Nathaniel -> Elizabeth -> Eliza, 5 generations: 4th cousin 7 times removed. After Henry Nicoll's death her mother became the third wife of Gen. John Smith, the U.S. Senator, who thus became Eliza's stepfather (S2). She married Richard Smith 5th; their son was Judge J. Lawrence Smith.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Parentage stated in Pelletreau twice and in Wikipedia's J. Lawrence Smith article.
